records.claim_text: CPO targets senior corporate payroll leadership and links a public editorial offer with an invite-only leadership group in The Payroll Community.
records.limitations: Positioning and access description, not evidence of membership scale or private activity.

records.claim_text: PayrollOrg’s January 2026 public article reports the CPO Forum launched in October 2025 and describes peer questions about communicating payroll value and choosing leadership metrics.
records.limitations: Selected organizer-published examples; no private answers or independently measured contribution rate.

records.claim_text: The CPO subscription page advertises quarterly executive payroll content by email at no cost, including strategic payroll, leadership and operational topics.
records.limitations: Free subscription is not proof that CPO Forum access is free or automatically granted.

records.claim_text: The broader Payroll Community terms describe a members’ peer community and prohibit product solicitation and advertisements, with removal or access suspension possible.
records.limitations: Broader platform rules; no separate CPO invitation agreement was visible. Not a documented sponsor-access package.

records.claim_text: The broader community terms caution against confidential posting, request permission before republishing, and contain a broad licence allowing PayrollOrg and community users to reuse posted material.
records.limitations: Licence and etiquette coexist. No legal interpretation or assurance of confidentiality; do not borrow as consent to JGA confidential research.

records.claim_text: The public CPO community shell requires login for announcements; its visible editorial feed is not equivalent to access to member discussion.
records.locator: cpo-community-home.parsed.txt CPO Home Page / Announcements; lines 27–51
records.limitations: No authentication attempted. Public activity rankings were not used to infer demand or engagement.

records.claim_text: Learning Futures London is advertised as a two-day Executive Knowledge Exchange on 17–18 November 2026 at Lloyds Banking Group, for CLOs and Global Heads of Learning.
records.limitations: Future announced event at 29 October 2026; venue, facilitators and registrations are not achieved attendance. L&D comparator, not payroll-specific.

records.claim_text: The London event page promises interactive discussion, problem-solving breakouts, peer coaching and networking, with free places for senior multinational-company leaders.
records.limitations: Advertised participant value, not measured outcomes. No formal guaranteed research deliverable established.

records.claim_text: The iVentiv FAQ makes free admission subject to organizer approval for VP/Director or other senior corporate delegates, describing a company-size threshold and global/regional responsibilities; travel and accommodation are excluded.
records.limitations: The cost answer says 10,000 or more employees; audience answer says more than 10,000. Preserve boundary discrepancy; not a universal free offer or payroll eligibility rule.
records.unit: employees, advertised qualifying threshold (boundary wording differs)

records.claim_text: iVentiv says event partners support free attendance; delegates may have scheduled partner conversations and can indicate preferred partners. The FAQ caps these at two or three sessions per day.
records.limitations: Organizer offer only; preference does not establish unrestricted refusal rights or private research access. No achieved meetings inferred.

records.claim_text: The FAQ describes a maximum of 40 executive-level participants and says pre-event questions help shape discussion topics.
records.limitations: Format cap and agenda input, not actual headcount, representative sample, or mandatory research contribution.
records.unit: advertised maximum executive participants per event

records.claim_text: The live iVentiv Business Development package advertises two sponsor delegate passes, nine pre-selected individual meetings, an exhibition area, logos, delegate contacts and invitations to a sponsor target list.
records.limitations: Public package inventory, not a signed London order or guarantee delivered meetings. Contact sharing is disclosed elsewhere; legal basis and contract conditions require event-specific review.

records.claim_text: The live Plenary package adds a sponsor-led 60-minute session, with sponsor choice of topic and format. Annual sponsorship is advertised from support of eight or more in-person events with extra promotional benefits.
records.limitations: No public price, VAT basis, actual sponsor revenue, event capacity sold or renewal rate verified. Does not establish independent research governance.

records.claim_text: iVentiv’s policy discloses attendee contact sharing with participants at the event and says pre-event inputs may be anonymised in aggregate reports; participants can decline surveys or request exclusion from reports.
records.limitations: Published general policy, not our consent or JGA rights. Does not confer permission to identify private respondents or transfer their answers to sponsors.

records.claim_text: iVentiv’s generic event terms require payment before the event but contain both 21-day and 14-day invoice provisions, with limited credits rather than broad cancellation refunds.
records.limitations: Ambiguous applicability to free delegates or exact sponsor package; no chosen invoice interval or sponsor cash-flow figure can be used.

records.claim_text: A digital senior-payroll forum plus free editorial stream is a direct low-travel substitute for some peer learning benefits of The Table; a dinner needs a distinct confidential research and decision-support return.
records.locator: Analyst synthesis from CPO offer and community rules
records.limitations: Inference about product design, not demonstrated buyer preference, willingness to pay or substitution behaviour.

records.claim_text: iVentiv separates a free executive seat from a commercial sponsor-access package. JGA should not promise that access by default while presenting The Table as confidential independent research.
records.locator: Analyst synthesis: iVentiv FAQ, package and privacy policy
records.limitations: Design implication, not a finding that JGA participants would reject sponsorship. JGA participant contacts and research answers remain outside sponsor rights unless separately agreed.
